name: garmin-mcp-local
description: Read your own Garmin Connect training and health data. Token-only auth, no password handling.
long_description: Runs from a local checkout you control rather than resolving an unpinned git branch at launch. Authentication is token-only: run `garmin-mcp-auth` once in a terminal to mint OAuth tokens. The server has no code path that accepts a password. Responses are summarised and stripped of account identifiers and GPS coordinates before reaching the model.

token_path.title: Token storage directory
token_path.description: Where garmin-mcp-auth stored your OAuth tokens. Run that command in a terminal before first use.
